lines: There you are, {player}! Look up. No, really, look up.
The stars over Observatory Hill keep blinking in a pattern. Tick, tick, tick. Like a clock. I don't like it.
Go up to the Observatory and have a look, will you? And keep your eyes open on the way. I dropped... I mean, I think there are schematics on that hill. Two of them!
If you find a ride schematic, take it to Zippy. Zippy builds rides faster than I can say "tailwhip".
WHOA. Hey! {player}! You made it! I knew you'd come. Well. I hoped. Mostly knew.
{player}: Where... am I? Who are you?
I'm Dash! And this is Galaxity! A planet that's sort of... outside of time. Time goes all stretchy here.
One hour of your Earth night is a whole day here. Dawn to dawn. Isn't that the best?
{player}: And this watch? It just appeared on my wrist!
Everyone who comes here gets one. It keeps time your own planet's way. It means you're... (He lowers his voice.) chosen.
{player}: Chosen for what?
Ah. Um. Can't say! Time ripples! Little wobbly ones! (He wobbles his hands.)
Come on! I'll be at the Market Square, by the fountain. I've got loads to show you!
There you are! OK, first things first. Gloops.
They're little goo blobs. Totally harmless, just really, really bouncy. And they bump into you. A lot.
That's what your Star Popper's for! It blows bubbles. Press {shoot} to blow one, and hold {aim} to aim. Pop three Gloops and you're a natural!

And this is my gadget stall, right here by the fountain! Gadgets do even sillier things than bubbles. I can only build one from its schematic, though. They blow about all over Galaxity, glowing blue. Find one and bring it here!
Oh, and Rex is at the Skate Park. He's my twin. He's a husky right now. Long story. He'll teach you to skate!
Tally has the request board in the square: people who need a hand. And Zippy runs the races, round the Lake Loop.
Oh! And see the fountain? Something shiny's stuck right on top of its water ball. A lost watch, I bet. I collect those!
How's it going, {player}? Gloops, my stall, Rex at the Skate Park, Tally's board, the watch on the fountain, and Zippy at the Lake Loop!
No rush! There's a whole day. And if you're out of time, there's always tomorrow night.
Check your quest log with {quest_log} to see what's left.
YOU DID IT! You popped the GLOOP KING! I saw the whole thing! Bubbles everywhere!
{player}: He was SO bouncy.
And look what he dropped. His crown! It's yours. Champion of the west fields!
(Dash looks past you, out over the far fields. His smile goes a bit wobbly.)
{player}: What is it?
Nothing! Probably nothing. Just... sometimes there's someone out there. Really, really big. Watching.
They call him the Agent of Chaos. Don't worry about him tonight. Tonight's a good night.
Enjoy the rest of the day! When the sky goes light, the portal will pull you home. See you next Shift?
Everyone's whispering about the Gloop King. Biggest, goldest Gloop there is. He holds court in the west fields, just past here.
Watch out for his belly-flop! It sends a ring of goo across the ground. Jump over it!
Bubbles make him wobble. Keep popping and he'll pop too. I'll cheer from here!
Champion of the west fields! (Dash bows.) Have fun till the sky goes light. The portal pulls you home at the end of the Shift.
Hi! Rex is so excited. Talk to him, he's doing a whole tour.
Watch the pink pointer on your watch's rim. The faster it pulses, the closer the ripple. Then just walk into it!
Rook won't come for us. Maybe he'll come for you? He's very food-motivated. And ball-motivated.
Ripples loaded, pods sealed, ball supplied. The big lever's on the console. It's probably safe!
{player}: Probably?
Very probably.
Go on, ask Rex. I want to see his face.
Whoa, hey! {player}! I mean... hi, stranger I have definitely never met before.
{player}: Do I know you?
Not yet! Well... kind of. It's complicated. Time stuff.
I'm Dash. I came here through the pond to fix something. A super important something.
{player}: What are you fixing?
Can't say! If I talk about the future too much it makes time ripples. Little wobbly ones.
{player}: Dash, Rex is running for mayor. What would you want a mayor to do?
A mayor? Rex? My twin brother Rex?
(Dash thinks about it, very fast.)
Okay, okay! A bike lane all the way round the lake! So I can zoom without bumping into anybody.
And tell him if he wins, I'm still not calling him Mayor Rex at breakfast.
{player}: Dash, I found this watch. It's a funny one.
(Dash's eyes go very wide.)
A lost watch! Everyone who lands here brings one. It tracks time the way it worked back home, wherever and whenever home was.
Some of the chosen kids have lost theirs. I'm collecting them. Trying to work out when everyone is from.
{player}: Why?
Can't say! Time ripples. Wobble wobble. But if you find more, bring them to me?
That's {watches_given} of 20. I'll keep it safe, promise.

rotate: Ooh, let me see! Hmm. This one's from a long way away. Or a long time away. Or both!
(Dash holds it up to his ear and listens, very seriously.)
Ticking like it's in a hurry. That's {watches_given} now!
Yes! You're a time detective. {watches_given} down, {watches_left} to go.

lines: Do you feel that? The portal's open! Time's all slow and stretchy right now.
{player}: Is that where you came from?
Ha! Uh... no comment. Time ripples, remember? Wobble wobble.
Out for a ride! Wind in my hair! ...Well, in my hat.
{player}: Where are you going?
Everywhere! Twice! Riding helps me think about... stuff. Future stuff. Shh.
Snack break! Do you know what they have for snacks in the fu-
(Dash claps a hand over his mouth.)
...Crackers. They have crackers. Totally normal crackers.
Sunsets here are the best. Pink and purple and a little bit sparkly.
{player}: Better than the ones where you come from?
Ha! Nice try. No comment.
(Dash yawns a giant yawn.)
Morning, {player}. Bike's ready. Brain's still... loading.
Hey, {player}. If you ever find a watch lying around, a funny-looking one, bring it to me?
People drop them when they land here. Whoosh, plonk. Gone.
{player}: What do they look like?
All different! Everybody counts time their own way. Sundials, hourglasses, beepy ones... Look up high, and down low.
Can't sleep. My brain's going boots-and-cats, boots-and-cats.
{player}: Boots and... cats?
That's how you say house music with your mouth! Try it! Boots-and-cats!
Morning! I already rode around the lake eleven times. Twelve. I lost count.
(Dash leans on his bike. The bike wobbles. Dash wobbles.)
I'm fine!

rotate: Leaning on my bike is my favorite way to stand. Ask anyone. Ask the bike.
The bike has never complained. Not once. Best friend ever.
Psst. Want to know something about the future?

lines: Okay. In the future, there's this giant...
(Dash stops. He squints at the sky.)
...nope. I felt a ripple. Sorry! Ask me again in, like, a hundred years.
Smart. Super smart. You'd be amazing at time travel.

rotate: Untz, untz, untz. That's the beat.
It's always playing in my head. It's a good song. You'd love it. Untz.
